placements.why: The directives establish an organizational governance discipline regarding the deliberate expungement of specific past decisions and technical migrations from memory.
placements.title: Organizational knowledge assets and historical records are actively pruned and expunged
placements.frame: How does the organization govern the retention, modification, and expungement of historical decisions and architectural knowledge?

placements.title: Superseded decisions and technical migration records are systematically expunged from organizational memory
placements.frame: Which specific decisions, migrations, and historical records are ordered to be expunged from organizational knowledge assets?
